items.title: AI Assistant · SaaS
items.description: AI assistant integrated directly into a web and mobile product.
details: Full pipeline: request preparation → API call → response transformation → final UI rendering.
Real-time communication via WebSockets (Node.js ↔ React ↔ Flutter).
UX design with Figma, error handling, timeouts, and partial streaming.

items.title: Feedback IA · Angular
items.description: Angular application connected to a FastAPI to display AI predictions and collect user feedback.
details: Designed a clean UI for prediction display and feedback collection.
Built a robust API with FastAPI and PostgreSQL.
Containerized the application with Docker for easy deployment.

items.title: Association Manager · Microservices
items.description: Modular web application to manage associations, projects, teams, and documents.
details: Developed with NestJS and Angular, following a microservices architecture.
Implemented role-based access control and document management.
Used PostgreSQL for data persistence and Docker for containerization.
